b:
Language,
religion,
caste,
race

Human,
to show yourself
as higher,
were these
all you could find?

When you roar
that your language
alone is superior,
the speech of the voiceless
falls as teardrops

When you go mad
crying religion is greatest,
humanity
falls onto its deathbed

Caste! Caste!
What have you achieved with it?
Did you win the boon of never dying?
All that is left
is graves

The koel that sings is black,
the swan that coos is white;
though the two sights differ,
what we gained by seeing them
was one and the same joy

You only need to hold
the one true thing called love in your heart;
so why do you have
these show-off demons behind you?

The same blood
that runs through
your six-foot body
runs in the next man too;
where did you find impurity in it?

Human, unless you too
change your heart,
these demons will not disappear
in tomorrow's
cremation ground of humankind
